tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: Girl Scouts of the United States of America (in this chapter, the “corporation”) is a body corporate and politic of the District of Columbia.

tree.heading: Domicile.—
tree.text: The domicile of the corporation is the District of Columbia.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the corporation has perpetual existence.
